note: Chapter 7 from docs/chapter-07/CHAPTER_07_PRODUCTION.md. Fictional highlands; see the cultural research note. Human lines are overheard.

caravan_east.speaker: narrator
caravan_east.text: The carnival is packing up. Painted wagons, folded tents, a ferris wheel lying on its side. A sign on the last wagon says EAST.

then.speaker: taro
then.text: The carnival always goes where people want to forget. Tonight that's east, over the sea. Hop on.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: The wagons roll onto a ferry made of lantern light. By dawn there are mountains.

C7_01_arrive.speaker: narrator
C7_01_arrive.text: Banjaran Awan, the Cloud Range. Green ridges, vegetable terraces, and a mist so thick it sits on the trail like a sleeping animal.

C7_01_arrive.speaker: reno
C7_01_arrive.text: It's so COLD. Is this what cold is?

C7_01_arrive.speaker: lumi
C7_01_arrive.text: The mist doesn't move. Mist always moves.

C7_01_arrive.speaker: elias
C7_01_arrive.text: Something is holding it still. Reno, could your Spirit Cyclone shift it?

C7_01_arrive.speaker: narrator
C7_01_arrive.text: New goal: clear the mist with Reno's Spirit Cyclone (Reno leads, face the mist, press A).

human_farmer.speaker: farmer
human_farmer.text: (to himself, digging) Cabbages like the cold. Cabbages like the cold. I do not like the cold, but cabbages do.

human_surveyor.speaker: surveyor
human_surveyor.text: (reading a map) The new road will go right over that ridge. Funny. The old people say nobody should build up there. They say it's spoken for.

ridge_trader.speaker: carnival_vendor
ridge_trader.text: Followed the carnival this far, did you? Honey from above the clouds!

mist_lumi.speaker: narrator
mist_lumi.text: A wall of still, white mist.

mist_lumi.speaker: lumi
mist_lumi.text: I can't push this. Reno's wind could. (Swap with C.)

pitcher_look.speaker: narrator
pitcher_look.text: A pitcher plant as big as a bucket. Something small is asleep inside.

mist_gone.speaker: narrator
mist_gone.text: Only a few wisps left, curling away.

C7_02_mist_1.speaker: narrator
C7_02_mist_1.text: Reno spins up a Spirit Cyclone. The mist tears like wet paper and blows away down the valley.

C7_02_mist_2.speaker: narrator
C7_02_mist_2.text: Spirit Cyclone! The mist peels back off the moss.

C7_02_mist_2.speaker: elias
C7_02_mist_2.text: Under the mist, the stones are carved. Old boundary marks.

C7_02_mist_3.speaker: narrator
C7_02_mist_3.text: Reno's last cyclone clears the trail. Beyond it, the mountain path climbs to a gate of grey stone.

C7_02_mist_3.speaker: lumi
C7_02_mist_3.text: Somebody put that mist here on purpose.

eh01_wisps_beaten.speaker: maris
eh01_wisps_beaten.text: Brr. Even their punches are cold.

eh03_silencers_beaten.speaker: narrator
eh03_silencers_beaten.text: The stone settles back down, quiet and harmless.

C7_02_moss.speaker: narrator
C7_02_moss.text: The Moss Forest. Every branch wears a green coat. Pitcher plants as big as buckets.

C7_02_moss.speaker: maris
C7_02_moss.text: This forest is very old. And very, very quiet. Too quiet. Birds should be singing.

C7_03_gate.speaker: narrator
C7_03_gate.text: The Guardian's Gate. Grey stones stand across the path in rows, and they are not making any sound at all. Not even the wind sounds near them.

C7_03_gate.speaker: narrator
C7_03_gate.text: In the middle of the path sits a boulder wearing a fern cloak. It opens two mossy eyes.

stone_locked.speaker: narrator
stone_locked.text: A grey stone, cold and silent. It's cracked, but none of us can break it.

stone_locked.speaker: reno
stone_locked.text: I kicked it. My foot is sad now.

stone_gone.speaker: narrator
stone_gone.text: Just rubble, and birdsong coming back.

C7_04_break_1.speaker: narrator
C7_04_break_1.text: Galen leans on the stone. It cracks, then crumbles. Somewhere nearby, a bird starts singing.

C7_04_break_2.speaker: narrator
C7_04_break_2.text: Galen puts one hand on the stone and pushes. It falls over like it was tired anyway.

C7_04_break_3.speaker: narrator
C7_04_break_3.text: Galen breaks the last silent stone. The sound of the whole mountain rushes back in: wind, water, birds, a faraway cowbell.

C7_04_break_3.speaker: galen
C7_04_break_3.text: He set these. Stones that eat sound. I used to think he only made quiet things for himself.

C7_03_galen_intro.speaker: galen
C7_03_galen_intro.text: Another one. Come to finish what the grey man started.

C7_03_galen_intro.speaker: lumi
C7_03_galen_intro.text: We're not with him! We're following him!

C7_03_galen_intro.speaker: galen
C7_03_galen_intro.text: That is what he said. Once. Long ago. Show me what you are.

C7_03_galen_intro.speaker: narrator
C7_03_galen_intro.text: Galen stands up. He is much, much bigger standing up.

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: galen
C7_03_galen_joins.text: ...Enough. He never fought like that. He fought like someone who wanted to lose.

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: galen
C7_03_galen_joins.text: I am Galen. I keep this gate. I kept it with the Oathkeepers, before they broke.

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: lumi
C7_03_galen_joins.text: You knew him. The man in the grey coat.

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: galen
C7_03_galen_joins.text: He was the youngest of us. In 1951 there was a crossing on the railway, and it went wrong, and he could not save everyone. Afterwards he stopped speaking. Then he stopped coming.

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: galen
C7_03_galen_joins.text: Last week he came back up the mountain. He would not look at me. He put silent stones across my path and went to the Oath Stone.

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: reno
C7_03_galen_joins.text: Then come with us! You can break those stones, right?

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: galen
C7_03_galen_joins.text: I can break most things. Slowly.

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: narrator
C7_03_galen_joins.text: Galen joined the party! In battle he draws attacks to himself and counters physical hits. Skills: Boulder Smash and Stone Rain (hits every enemy). In the field he breaks silent stones.

C7_03_galen_joins.speaker: narrator
C7_03_galen_joins.text: New goal: break the silent stones and climb to the Oath Stone.

C7_05_summit.speaker: narrator
C7_05_summit.text: The summit. A tall stone, carved with names, stands at the top of the world. Something without a face is wrapped around it like smoke.

oath_stone_before.speaker: narrator
oath_stone_before.text: The Hush is wrapped around the stone. You can't get close.

oath_stone_after.speaker: narrator
oath_stone_after.text: The Oath Stone. Names in old letters, and one long scrape where a name used to be.

C7_05_hush_intro.speaker: narrator
C7_05_hush_intro.text: The Hush turns. Where it looks, sound stops. Reno opens his mouth to shout and nothing comes out.

C7_05_hush_intro.speaker: galen
C7_05_hush_intro.text: He left this here to guard the stone. To keep it from telling anyone what he did.

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: narrator
C7_05_hush_outro.text: The Hush breaks apart like a held breath let go. Reno's shout finally comes out, three minutes late. "...AAAAH!"

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: narrator
C7_05_hush_outro.text: The Oath Stone hums. Up close the names glow faintly, all except the scraped one.

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: galen
C7_05_hush_outro.text: He scraped out his own name. He thinks he is not an Oathkeeper any more.

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: narrator
C7_05_hush_outro.text: Got the Oath Stone Rubbing and the Moss Mantle (Galen: DEF +3, RES +2).

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: narrator
C7_05_hush_outro.text: Then the stone speaks, in a tired voice the party has never heard but somehow knows.

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: keeper_voice
C7_05_hush_outro.text: If anyone is listening: I am sorry. On the night of the Lantern Moon the worlds will touch, the way they did in 1951. This time I will be ready. When it is over, I will close every door between them. Nobody will be lost again.

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: reno
C7_05_hush_outro.text: Close every door? But then... Lumi and me...

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: lumi
C7_05_hush_outro.text: We'd never see the human world again. And they'd never even know we were gone.

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: galen
C7_05_hush_outro.text: The Lantern Moon is three nights from now. The worlds will touch in many places at once.

C7_05_hush_outro.speaker: elias
C7_05_hush_outro.text: Then we split up and hold them. All of us.
